rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance, chapter 14.04
rules.requirement: Prohibits housing discrimination, including based on source of income (Section 8 and public benefits). Landlords may use any reasonable tenant-selection standard applied equally to all applicants, such as ability to pay rent and ability to care for the apartment and respect others' rights.
rules.penalty: Civil fines of up to $300 per violation, plus possible criminal complaint, injunctive relief, and damages, expenses and other relief.
rules.status_basis: Described as an ordinance the Commission currently enforces.

exempt_if.text: exemption for 2-family dwellings, when the owner lives there

coverage.summary: Applies to housing rentals in Cambridge generally.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Two-family dwellings where the owner lives are exempt.
